# 重新構想 GUI - 淺色版

[![Modrinth 上的 Unique Dark](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/modrinth@2x.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimaginedguidark)
[![CurseForge 上的 Unique Dark](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/curseforge@2x.png?raw=true)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/reimaginedguidark)
[![amongstreality 的 Patreon](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/patreon@2x.png?raw=true)](https://www.patreon.com/c/AmongstReality)
[![amongstreality 的 Buy Me a Coffee](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/bmc@2x.png?raw=true)](https://buymeacoffee.com/amongstreality)

替換遊戲中的所有容器介面，並更改快捷欄、生命值與護甲圖示。

> 如果你正在尋找深色版本，可以在此處找到 [Reimagined GUI - 深色版](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimaginedguidark)

## 支援我與我的專案

[![Patreon](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/labeled/patreon@3x.png?raw=true)](https://www.patreon.com/c/AmongstReality)
[![Buy Me a Coffee](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/labeled/bmc@3x.png?raw=true)](https://buymeacoffee.com/amongstreality)

## 模組支援

- [Backslot](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/backslot)
- [Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/capes)
- [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios)
- [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi)
- [Inventorio](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/inventorio)
- [MidnightControls](https://modrinth.com/mod/midnightcontrols)
- [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports)
- [Vanilla Notebook](https://modrinth.com/mod/notebook)
- [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip)
- [Metal Barrels](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/metal-barrels/files)

- 在 Modrinth/CurseForge 上的公開整合包中。
- 若想為該資源包製作模組相容性擴充套件。若如此做，你必須清楚標明出處，並包含原始資源包的連結。
- 對原始資源包進行的任何私人修改。

你**不能**使用我的素材的情境：

- 在 Bedrock Marketplace（基岩版市場）上散發。
- 設置付費牆（例如 Patreon）。
- 在任何平台上散發原始或修改過的素材。

該資源包在各平台的頁面連結：

- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/reimaginedguilight)
- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimaginedguilight)

</details>
